originality.rationale: The assessed claim is the exact all-r finite census of complete FO2 sentence theories and the sharp full-theory induced-substructure bound in the signature with exactly one equivalence predicate and r unary predicates. The inspected Fiuk 2026 work addresses broader equality-free logical fragments; Kieroński--Otto 2005 shows generic FO2 one-equivalence finite-model/small-model results; Pratt-Hartmann 2015 includes stronger counting quantifiers. None of the inspected corresponding sections or targeted mathematical-record searches stated the exact double-truncated profile criterion and both sharp formulas. The underlying EF technique is standard; historical priority under alternative names remains uncertain.
residual_risks: Older unindexed model-theoretic descriptions of colored set partitions, two-pebble bisimulation types or S5-style equivalence frames may directly imply this exact classification.
The publisher article with counting was not exhaustively read through all technical sections; the publicly inspected claims do not resolve priority absolutely.
Scientific review is same-model only. The finite checker covers carriers of size at most six for one color and five for two colors, rather than all cardinalities.

value.rationale: The one-equivalence, unary-colored two-variable signature is a motivated interface between monadic logic and modal equivalence semantics. The theorem completely classifies all elementary theories, gives an exact formula for their number, and yields the optimal size of an induced finite substructure that preserves every sentence (not merely a single formula). The uniform bound has a matching one-sentence obstruction and a concrete exact 6560-theory one-unary-predicate instance. This finite structural invariant is neither a textbook normalization check nor an arbitrary numerical slice.
